name: Euro 2024 upset-pressure frozen recommendation suite
description: Local frozen Euro 2024 group-stage stress sample for checking favorite fragility, upset capture, and calibration pressure.
notes: This suite is intentionally local and deterministic.
It does not call provider APIs and is not user-facing recommendation copy.
The default gate should reject uncalibrated longshot overrides; stricter gates that require solver influence can still use this as a cold-match exposure stress suite.
Manual frozen group-stage sample used to expand upset and favorite-fragility coverage.
